fee_notes: No ongoing royalty or marketing fees. Variable as-needed fees include: on-site assistance ($105/hour), additional training ($750/person), website development (cost+5%), materials ($0.07-$3,500/item depending on type), validation (50% of $43-$250/candidate), customization ($43-$250/hour), legal services ($265/hour in-house), registration/exemption costs (varies by state, $0-$1,000), audit software (50% of costs), inspection/audit costs (varies), software maintenance fees (varies), and conditional monthly software licenses if not operating Unit Franchise (email/Microsoft $23.98-$42.61/user, CRM $87.63-$113.07/user, cloud storage $6.69-$8.63/user, franchise sales management $15/user). All fees non-refundable and subject to increase.
